disposition_reason: Survey of manganese in infant formulas and young-child beverages (US and French markets) by PIXE/RBS; two chocolate-containing formula/beverage products without Mn supplementation had the highest Mn (up to 220 ug/100 kcal). Only manganese was measured (not a tracked analyte) and the products are chocolate-flavoured composites, not cocoa or chocolate.
disposition_locator: Tables 1 and 2 ('Chocolate' column, PDF pp.7-8); Fig 1 and Table 3 discussion (PDF pp.8-10); Discussion PDF p.10 ('Two of the products ... used chocolate as an ingredient')

study.material_scope: infant formulas and toddler beverages incl. chocolate-flavoured products (composite)
